minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, January 17th, 2024
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, January 17th, 2024.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Rafaela Giles, Jenny Jolly, Edward
  Padgett, Bette Donovan, and Scott Snider

  Members Absent: None

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Community Services Specialist, Chad Peterson, Community Services
  Supervisor.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, November
  15th, 2023 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 34 participants per week
  in November and Meals were served to an average of 31 participants per week in
  December.

  Meals on Wheels: 639 meals served to 46 La Verne recipients in December.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through January 17th, 2024
  was $307.00. The average attendance for November to December was 49
  players per week.

5. Account Balance: $5,030.86.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for November. The senior program fee
  will be raised to $1.00 after the first of the year.

7. MT. SAC Classes: In Winter Session. Registration for Spring has begun.
 8. Aging Next: 10 La Verne residents served in November and 9 La Verne
  residents served in December.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Aquatic Center, bid approved. La Verne won the contest for
  Perk your Park and will receive $75,000. Still working on bids.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Tuesday, January 23rd – Excursion, USS Iowa Battleship Tour and Seal Beach Pier,
  8:15AM-5:15PM.
  - Wednesday, January 31st – Senior Seminar: Diabetes, Presented by
  Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  - Wednesday, February 7th– Senior Seminar: High Blood Pressure/Stress
  Management, Presented by Optum, 9:30AM.
  - Friday, February 9th – Excursion, Norton Simon Museum, 11:00AM-4:30PM.
  - Tuesday, February 20th – Excursion, Valley View Casino, 8:30AM-6:30PM.

11. Public Comments: George Borst announced Golf has been turned over to Marv.
  Bingo will add some easier games. Scott Snider announced Hillcrest will have
  catering back for events.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 10:20AM.
  Motion carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, February 21st, 2024 at
  10:00AM.
